_comment: Which tests each guard's absence must break, by name.
The harness used to publish how MANY tests failed. Independent review ran it
twice at the same commit and got different tables - a flake anywhere in the
2043-test suite is attributed to whichever guard happened to be mutated at
that moment, and the baseline/final integrity checks cannot see it because
the flake only manifests mid-table. A count is not a measurement when the
Identities fix that. A mutation is measured by which named tests it breaks;
an unexpected extra failure is a flake and the cell is re-run, and a missing
expected failure is a guard that stopped being load-bearing. Both are
reported rather than silently folded into a number.
Widening a set is a deliberate edit, and that is the point. Strengthening
the end-to-end connection test so it detects a collapsed plan gave the
narrowing guard a second test, and the harness refused to publish anything
until this file said so rather than quietly absorbing the change.
narrowing: the prompt builder is never told which arm it is serving
a ready candidate runs the plan and reaches the validator and the aggregator
purity: a builder whose output depends on anything but its input fails the unit
armIdentity: a prompt that names an arm fails the units of that arm
resumeSeed: a resumed attempt cannot adopt a different outer instruction
indexRebuild: a hand-made index is revalidated, not trusted for its schema tag
required coverage is checked against validated kinds, not claimed ones
byte-identity holds for a hand-made index too, not only a built one
requiredDigest: verification refuses to run without the digest it is meant to check
canonical: a real run may use only the frozen prompt builder
scoredRefusal: the runner itself refuses a scored run, not merely the layer above it
envType: a placeholder in a numeric field is not an observation
serviceTag: a service pinned by tag is not pinned
a service image and its recorded digest cannot disagree
modelDigest: a short model identifier cannot pin weights — this is blocker B1 in code
